{{Quote|Sabaoth Squadron. Nasty group of mercenaries. Last time I ran into 'em, Nym had to bail me out.|[[Reti]] to [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter]]''</ref>}}
'''Sabaoth Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Cavik Toth]]. During the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] leading up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], they were a independent [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] outfit. They joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], whereby Toth's starfighters were used to bolster [[Confederate Navy/Legends|naval]] defenses and fight [[Nym/Legends|Nym's]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] and [[Sol Sixxa]]'s command of the [[Mere Resistance]] at [[Karthakk system]] and finally fighting both [[Karthakk system|Karthakk's]] pirate groups and the new [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]].
